lab.title: Lesson 4.3: Network Security
lab.blurb: Vex scans every door of the Citadel's outer hull. Scan it yourself first, then block every port that shouldn't be open.

story.vex: Twenty-one, eighty, three-three-eight-nine. Three doors, and only one should even exist. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. The re-scan shows two doors welded shut and one, the one we need, still open. Astro: "Scan your own walls before Doom does. Now you know how."

steps.title: Volt's Drill: scan the outer hull, then block every door that shouldn't be open
steps.body: Volt: "Astro authorized this: scan our own hull first, so Doom finds nothing we haven't already found." From `volt`, check what's listening on `outer-hull`: `Test-NetConnection 192.168.5.20 -Port 21`, `-Port 80`, and `-Port 3389`. FTP (21) and RDP (3389) have no business being open to the network; the web port (80) does. Rivet: "Turning the firewall on blocks everything by default, so allowlist exactly what the crew needs." On `outer-hull`: `netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state on`, then `netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name=BlockFTP dir=in action=block protocol=TCP localport=21`, the same for `localport=3389`, and finally `netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name=AllowWeb dir=in action=allow protocol=TCP localport=80` so the one service the crew needs stays reachable.

objectives.label: Port 80 (the web service) is still open
